gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-cham: Marker-tip letters, loud and loose. Noto Sans Cham follows in rounded, generously opened forms, giving the heading's bold strokes a softer, easier partner underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-chero: Funnel Display draws every stroke at one fixed width, with no hairlines anywhere. Noto Sans Cherokee follows with a deep band of letters and a wide gap at the e, so the text beneath feels open and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-ethio: Funnel Display holds one fixed nib width, spaghetti-like and unmistakably expressive. Noto Sans Ethiopic carries a sturdy lowercase with terminals hanging far from the bowl, so a long passage feels steady and unfussy to move through.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-georg: Funnel Display swaps thin hairline joins for full-width stroke connections, which gives its letters a bold, drawn-in-one-go feel above Noto Sans Georgian. Its place is in headings, where its loud shapes can carry the page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-glago: Noto Sans Glagolitic offers open round letters and a sturdy lowercase that stay readable even when small. Funnel Display, meanwhile, is the one with the marker-like line and the commanding voice, built to announce rather than to explain.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-gothi: Funnel Display never varies its line weight. Noto Sans Gothic is the one with lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads and round forms like open parentheses, made to be read line after line while the heading simply makes its statement.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-grant: Noto Sans Grantha runs compact, with bowls pressed flat. Funnel Display's pencil-like lines, which never thicken or thin, sit over it with a bold confidence while the sans below keeps the reading smooth.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-gunja: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has strokes as thick as a crayon mark and terminals cut back to leave a big gap. And Funnel Display's single-width pen line holds up best at large sizes, with the body text kept modest beneath it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-hebre: No modulation anywhere: stems and connecting strokes in Funnel Display match. Noto Sans Hebrew brings a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems, and the heading does its best work big and brief above that plain sans.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-jp: Funnel Display is all bold letters with no thick or thin strokes. Noto Sans JP brings a very large x-height and curves that sweep open, so a long passage would feel smooth and unclogged beneath that heavy heading.
